mica.definition: n. any of various minerals consisting of hydrous silicates of aluminum or potassium etc. that crystallize in forms that allow perfect cleavage into very thin leaves; used as dielectrics because of their resistance to electricity

micaceous.definition: a. hydrous silicates of or relating to or resembling mica
micaceous.translation:
a. 云母的, 云母状的, 含云母的
[医] 云母的, 碎屑状的

micacite.translation: 云母片岩; 云母片岩

micafolium.translation: 云母箔; 胶合云母箔

micah.definition:
n. a minor Hebrew prophet (8th century BC)
n. an Old Testament book telling the prophecies of Micah foretelling the destruction of Jerusalem
micah.translation: n. 弥迦(希伯来先知), <<弥迦书>>

micanite.translation: [化] 层合云母板; 绝缘石

micas.definition:
plural of mica
n. any of various minerals consisting of hydrous silicates of aluminum or potassium etc. that crystallize in forms that allow perfect cleavage into very thin leaves; used as dielectrics because of their resistance to electricity
micas.translation:
(mica 的复数) n. 云母
[化] 云母

micawber.definition: n. fictional character created by Charles Dickens; an eternal optimist

micawberish.translation: a. 米考伯式的, 无远虑而老想走运的
